## What it is

Socket.IO client v4.8.1 (MIT, Guillermo Rauch), minified.

## How it works

- Loaded on demand by Netplay to talk to the signalling server.

## Why it exists

Netplay needs real-time bidirectional messaging for room lists, chat and WebRTC negotiation.

- Not in the service worker's pre-cache list; it is cached at runtime when first used.
